declarations.description:
Rows × columns of checkboxes or radio buttons in one form control: the permissions of GitHub and Okta (resources ×
read, write, admin), notification preferences (events × email, push, SMS) or a survey's agreement scale.

With `type="checkbox"` each row takes any number of columns; with `type="radio"` exactly one, and the arrow keys move
along the row. `toggles` adds tri-state checkboxes that check or clear a whole row, a whole column, or a column within
a group of rows (rows that share a `group` are listed under a header row). A disabled row or column keeps its
choices and is skipped by the toggles.

`value` maps each row's `value` to the checked columns' values (a string for radio rows). Under a `name`, a form
receives one `name[row]=column` entry per choice. `required` asks for at least one choice, or for every row to be
answered with `type="radio"`. The control takes part in `c2-form-field`, which names and describes it.

Each choice is named by its row and column, and the matrix is a table: a screen reader reads the column title as it
moves along a row. On a narrow screen the table scrolls sideways with its first column held in place.

members.name: rows
members.description: The rows. As an attribute, a JSON array of `{ value, label, description, group, disabled }`.

members.name: columns
members.description: The columns. As an attribute, a JSON array of `{ value, label, disabled }`.

members.name: value
members.description: The choices, by row value. As an attribute, JSON: `{"issues":["read","write"]}`, or `{"q1":"agree"}` for radio rows.

members.name: type
members.description: Any number of columns per row, or exactly one.

members.name: toggles
members.description: Tri-state checkboxes that check or clear a whole row, a whole column (and a column within each group), or both. Checkbox matrices only.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives `name[row]=column` for each choice.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for at least one choice, or for every row to be answered with `type="radio"`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns every choice and toggle off; the value is kept and, as for a disabled form control, not submitted.

members.name: rowHeader
members.description: The title above the row labels.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the matrix. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: chosen
members.description: The columns chosen for a row, always as a list.

members.name: mixed
members.description: How many of the enabled cells among `cells` are checked.

members.name: commit
members.description: Sets the checked state of `cells`, then announces the change.

members.name: renderToggle
members.description: A tri-state checkbox over `cells`: checked when all are, mixed when some are. Pressing it checks them all, or clears them all when all were.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the user changes a choice, before `change`. Read `value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user changes a choice. `detail.value` is the new `value`. Not fired for programmatic changes.
